|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230907173812/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-lgbt-uniforms-idUSKCN1T512Q |url-status=live}}</ref> In 2022, she became the first head of government of Mexico City to attend the [[Mexico City Pride|city's gay pride march]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 June 2022 |title=Claudia Sheinbaum, la primer Jefa de gobierno en asistir a la marcha LGBT+
|trans-title=Claudia Sheinbaum, the first head of government to attend the LGBT+ march|url=https://heraldodemexico.com.mx/nacional/2022/6/25/claudia-sheinbaum-la-primer-jefa-de-gobierno-en-asistir-la-marcha-lgbt-416637.html |access-date=7 September 2023 |website=El Heraldo de México |language=es |archive-date=7 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230907173811/https://heraldodemexico.com.mx/nacional/2022/6/25/claudia-sheinbaum-la-primer-jefa-de-gobierno-en-asistir-la-marcha-lgbt-416637.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

===Economy===
Sheinbaum has criticized the [[neoliberal]] economic policies of past presidents of Mexico, arguing that they have contributed to inequality in the country.<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 March 2023 |title=Could scientist Claudia Sheinbaum be Mexico's next leader? |url=https://apnews.com/article/mexico-elections-president-claudia-sheinbaum-0c9e55ea616f7af7535967f4b99b6ea6 |access-date=7 September 2023 |website=AP News |language=en |archive-date=7 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230907015304/https://apnews.com/article/mexico-elections-president-claudia-sheinbaum-0c9e55ea616f7af7535967f4b99b6ea6 |url-status=live}}</ref> She has promised to expand welfare under her presidency<ref>{{cite news |last1=Madry |first1=Kylie |last2=Hilaire |first2=Valentine |title=Claudia Sheinbaum wins sweeping mandate, becomes Mexico's first female president |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/claudia-sheinbaum-claims-sweeping-mandate-become-mexicos-first-female-president-2024-06-03/ |access-date=3 June 2024 |work=[[Reuters]] |date=3 June 2024}}</ref> and intends to continue programs started by López Obrador, such as universal pension.<ref>{{cite news |title=Mexico elects Claudia Sheinbaum as its first woman president |url=https://www.euronews.com/2024/06/03/mexico-set-to-elect-first-female-president-as-exit-polls-point-to-sheinbaum-victory |access-date=3 June 2024 |work=Euro News |date=3 June 2024 |archive-date=3 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240603051729/https://www.euronews.com/2024/06/03/mexico-set-to-elect-first-female-president-as-exit-polls-point-to-sheinbaum-victory |url-status=live}}</ref>

===Environment===
Sheinbaum has a background in environmental policy, having served as Minister of the Environment for Mexico City and worked on the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC),<ref name="cnn-profile">{{cite news |last1=Magramo |first1=Kathleen |last2=Suarez |first2=Karol |last3=John |first3=Tara |title=She is set to be Mexico's first female president. But who is Claudia Sheinbaum? |url=https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/03/americas/mexico-claudia-sheinbaum-profile-intl-hnk/index.html |access-date=3 June 2024 |work=[[CNN]] |date=3 June 2024 |archive-date=4 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604022656/https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/03/americas/mexico-claudia-sheinbaum-profile-intl-hnk/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> which would go on to win the panel a [[Nobel Prize|Nobel Peace Prize]].<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Kitroeff |first1=Natalie |last2=Suner |first2=Rebecca |last3=Shaman |first3=Christina |date=4 June 2024 |title=Video: What to Know About Claudia Sheinbaum, Mexico's President-Elect |url=https://www.nytimes.com/video/world/americas/100000009504420/what-to-know-about-claudia-sheinbaum-mexicos-president-elect.html |access-date=6 June 2024 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331 |archive-date=6 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240606215135/https://www.nytimes.com/video/world/americas/100000009504420/what-to-know-about-claudia-sheinbaum-mexicos-president-elect.html |url-status=live}}</ref> In her tenure as Minister of the Environment, she saw a marked reduction in air pollution and created community ecological reserves.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Encuentro Virtual: 30 Años De Gestión De Calidad del Aire en la Zona Metropolitana del Valle de México |url=https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/606973/MEMORIA_Encuentro_30_an_os_AJUSTES_ene16_portadayContra.pdf |access-date=4 April 2023 |date=20 October 2020 |archive-date=4 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230404085723/https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/606973/MEMORIA_Encuentro_30_an_os_AJUSTES_ene16_portadayContra.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref> She has both spoken in favor of clean energy and support of oil, praising [[PEMEX]] (the nation's state-owned oil company).<ref name="sherman-profile">{{cite news |last1=Sherman |first1=Christopher |title=A scientist, a leftist and a former Mexico City mayor. Who is Claudia Sheinbaum? |url=https://apnews.com/article/claudia-sheinbaum-mexico-presidential-election-profile-5f61250aaccb9f397f74ff6c7cfe9cc0 |access-date=3 June 2024 |work=Associated Press |date=3 June 2024 |archive-date=3 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240603074521/https://apnews.com/article/claudia-sheinbaum-mexico-presidential-election-profile-5f61250aaccb9f397f74ff6c7cfe9cc0 |url-status=live}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
In 1986, Sheinbaum met [[Carlos Ímaz|Carlos Ímaz Gispert]], who later became a prominent political figure in the PRD during his tenure at [[Stanford University]]. They married in 1987 and divorced in 2016.<ref name=marriages>{{cite news|url=https://mexiconewsdaily.com/news/claudia-sheinbaum-gets-married-in-small-civil-ceremony/|title=Claudia Sheinbaum gets married in small civil ceremony|publisher=Mexico Daily News|date=20 November 2023|access-date=1 October 2024}}</ref> They have a daughter who was born in 1988.<ref name=marriages /> 

In 2016, she began dating [[Jesús María Tarriba|Jesús María Tarriba Unger]], a financial risk analyst for the [[Bank of Mexico]], whom she had known as a university student.<ref name=dating>{{cite web|url=https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/2022/11/23/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-futuro-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-297474.html|title=Who is Jesús María Tarriba Unger, future husband of Claudia Sheinbaum|publisher=Proceso|language=Spanish|date=23 November 2023|access-date=5 December 2023|archive-date=5 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231205195059/https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/2022/11/23/quien-es-jesus-maria-tarriba-unger-futuro-esposo-de-claudia-sheinbaum-297474.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=marriages />
In November 2023, Sheinbaum announced her marriage to Tarriba via social media.<ref name=dating/> The two married in a small civil ceremony.<ref name=marriages />

===Other awards===
* Jesus Silva Herzog Award (1995). Awarded by the National Autonomous University of Mexico's Institute for Economic Research for her outstanding contributions in the field of economics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Biografía de Claudia Sheinbaum (Su vida, historia, bio resumida) |url=https://www.buscabiografias.com/biografia/verDetalle/10952/Claudia%20Sheinbaum |access-date=17 February 2025 |website=buscabiografias.com}}</ref>
* UNAM Prize for Young Academics (2001). Awarded for her contributions to academia while working at the National Autonomous University of Mexico.<ref name="allblogthings.com">{{Cite web |date=3 June 2024 |title=Claudia Sheinbaum: Meet Mexico's President-Elect and Accomplished Scientist |url=https://www.allblogthings.com/2024/06/claudia-sheinbaum.html |access-date=17 February 2025 |website=All Blog Things – A Tech & Business Magazine!}}</ref>
* The Sustainability Medal (2024). Awarded by the Nobel Sustainability Trust<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nobelsustainabilitytrust.org/|title=Nobel Sustainability Trust|website=NST}}</ref> for her global leadership in sustainability and climate change policies.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024 |title=President of Mexico Claudia Sheinbaum, was awarded the Medal of Outstanding Contribution to Sustainability |url=https://www.nobelsustainabilitytrust.org/the-sustainability-medal-2024 |access-date=3 March 2025 |website=Nobel Sustainability Trust}}</ref>
* Sheinbaum was part of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) team that received the [[Nobel Peace Prize]] in [[2007 Nobel Peace Prize|2007]] for their work on advancing the understanding of man-made climate change.<ref name="allblogthings.com"/>

== Selected bibliography ==
Sheinbaum is the author of over 100 articles and two books on energy, the environment, and [[sustainable development]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.jewishpress.com/news/jewish-news/mexico-city-gets-first-female-jewish-mayor/2018/07/02/ |title=Mexico City Gets First Female Jewish Mayor |work=Jewish Press |date=2 July 2018 |access-date=25 April 2020 |archive-date=19 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190519210249/https://www.jewishpress.com/news/jewish-news/mexico-city-gets-first-female-jewish-mayor/2018/07/02/ |url-status=live}}</ref> A selection follows:
* ''Consumo de energía y emisiones de {{CO2}} del autotransporte en México y Escenarios de Mitigación'', Ávila-Solís JC, Sheinbaum-Pardo C. 2016.
* Decomposition analysis from demand services to material production: The case of {{CO2}} emissions from steel produced for automobiles in Mexico'', Applied Energy, 174: 245–255,'' Sheinbaum-Pardo C. 2016.
* The impact of energy efficiency standards on residential electricity consumption in Mexico'', Energy for Sustainable Development, 32:50–61'' Martínez-Montejo S.A., Sheinbaum-Pardo C. 2016.
* Science and Technology in the framework of the Sustainable Development Goals, World Journal of Science'', Technology and Sustainable Development, 14:2 – 17''. Imaz M. Sheinbaum C. 2017.
* Assessing the Impacts of Final Demand on {{CO2}}-eq Emissions in the Mexican Economy: An Input-Output Analysis'', Energy and Power Engineering, 9:40–54'', Chatellier D, Sheinbaum C. 2017.
* Electricity sector reforms in four Latin-American countries and their impact on carbon dioxide emissions and renewable energy'','' Ruíz- Mendoza BJ, Sheinbaum-Pardo C. ''Energy Policy'', 2010
* Energy consumption and related {{CO2}} emissions in five Latin American countries: Changes from 1990 to 2006 and perspectives'','' Sheinbaum C, Ruíz BJ, Ozawa L. ''Energy'', 2010.
* Mitigating Carbon Emissions while Advancing National Development Priorities: The Case of Mexico, C Sheinbaum, O Masera, ''Climatic Change'', Springer, 2000.
* Energy use and {{CO2}} emissions for Mexico's cement industry, C Sheinbaum, L Ozawa, ''Energy'', Elsevier, 1998.
* Energy use and {{CO2}} emissions in Mexico's iron and steel industry, L Ozawa, C Sheinbaum, N Martin, E Worrell, L Price, ''Energy'', Elsevier, 2002.
* ''New trends in industrial energy efficiency in the Mexico iron and steel industry'', L Ozawa, N Martin, E Worrell, L Price, C Sheinbaum, [[OSTI]], 1999.
* Mexican Electric end-use Efficiency: Experiences to Date, R Friedmann, C Sheinbaum, ''Annual Review of Energy and the Environment'', 1998.
* Incorporating Sustainable Development Concerns into Climate Change Mitigation: A Case Study, OR Masera, C Sheinbaum, ''Climate Change and Development'', UDLAP, 2000.
